observations.last_message: Synthesis finished with 0 errors, 0 critical warnings and 553 warnings
observations.actual_call: synth_design had not returned to generated loader_bd.tcl; rename_ref/write_checkpoint had not executed
observations.conclusion: Confirmed inactive OOC synthesis stall, not evidence of current Ara RTL timing failure. The proprietary internal wait cause is not yet proven.

workflow_findings.issue: IP preparation used bare wait_on_run, bypassing managed crash/log checks and periodic named-run progress
workflow_findings.repair: Use fpga_run::wait_checked and publish run name, log size and last log write time
workflow_findings.limit: Progress reporting is not automatic deadlock detection; quiet phases are not killed based on elapsed time alone

workflow_findings.issue: Fresh frozen builds regenerated unchanged OOC IPs; release wrapper had no explicit verified prepared-project continuation
workflow_findings.repair: Allow an explicitly configured immutable package/project, re-open it and require check_ips before continuation; reject stale, failed, locked or missing checkpoints
workflow_findings.limit: No blind cross-project DCP copying or spoofing completion markers

workflow_findings.issue: Coarse root state did not expose which IP was being waited on; a live process was incorrectly treated as useful progress
workflow_findings.repair: Add wait_progress.tcllist snapshots and separate per-mode tool logs; operational status must consider log and CPU progress, not process existence alone

recovery.process_action: Saved logs, input scripts, process tree, CPU delta and Windows wait chains; stopped only owned hung build processes, including its orphan task worker
recovery.attempt_02: Backup glob selected a marker twice; stopped before reset or synthesis. Fixed by deduplicating paths; failed attempt retained
recovery.attempt_03: One controlled loader-only retry with general.maxThreads=1 and synth.maxThreads=1; preserve other completed OOC runs
recovery.after_recovery: Recheck all IPs, then automatic current-RTL synthesis, incremental implementation, routed audit, bitgen, board smoke and Linux checks
recovery.not_yet_proven: Single-thread retry resolves the proprietary wait; new bitstream timing and Linux boot remain unverified

regression.managed_run_mock_regression: passed, including quiet valid phases and failure rejection
